newsitem.title: USA: Factory Card slammed by earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Factory Card slammed by earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of Factory Card Outlet Corp dropped about 35 percent Thursday after the party supplies and greeting card retailer said its fourth quarter and fiscal year earnings will fall short of Wall Street expectations.
Factory Card dropped 3-1/8 to 5-3/4 with about 2.3 million shares traded by mid-afternoon, compared with an average daily trading volume of only 33,070 shares.

After the market closed on Wednesday, Factory Card said it expects its fourth quarter earnings to be in the range of $0.22 to $0.25 a share, which is below analysts' consensus expectations of $0.34 a share.

The company said its fourth quarter results were hurt by some stores opening later than planned, some merchandise issues and an attempt to spur earlier Mother's Day business by mailing advertising a week earlier than it had last year.

For the full fiscal year, Factory Card said it expects its earnings to be in the range of $0.18 to $0.22 a share, compared with analysts' estimates of $0.33. In the prior fiscal year, the company reported earnings of $0.01 a share.
Alex. Brown, which served as the lead underwriter of Factory Card's initial public offering in December, downgraded the stock to buy from strong buy.
